_comment: WAS `recommended` before v5.1, at an expected value of $0.18. Risk 0.2643 sits just BELOW the 0.2654 portfolio average, and OFF-AUTOPAY -- the only offer that applied -- was worth 18 cents. R3 read `EV > 0`, so it passed, and this customer consumed a queue slot and a model call. With a $20.00 minimum the offer is vetoed and, being below the base rate, the customer lands here. This file is kept deliberately as the worked example of what the minimum fixed.
